title: Glass (Sulfur) Cube
description: Sulfur Cube is now made of clean glass to better see the block inside and to look more modern, perfect for contemporary buildings and games
body:
The glass texture adds a modern and contemporary touch and allows the material/type of cube to be seen more clearly.

- Changes the outer texture of the brand new _Sulfur Cube_ mob to make it look like a block of glass.
- The inner texture is removed to better see the block inside.
- Goo particle texture also changed to glass texture.

I hope you find this resource pack interesting!
